label: sec:atom-isotope-confinement-intro
html: This section proves existence, uniqueness, continuity, and local constancy of the shadow-price ordering off the phase-boundary variety, and concludes by deriving the zero-parameter per-component linking-weight selection rule \mathrm{lw}(c)(q) = \frac{1}{c+1}\sum_{\lambda \vdash (c+1)} \dim_q V_\lambda at its exact c = 1 (knot), c = 3 (Borromean link), and c = 2 (Hopf link) anchors.
